name: print-social-violet-and-lime-business-growth-posts-with-qr-code
title: Violet business posts with lime arc framing a team photo and a QR 'Unlock your market value'
whatItIs: Two portrait posts on violet: one with 'Register Now & Grow' in lime above a team photo cropped by a thick lime arc and violet circles; one with 'Let's Unlock Your True Market Value', a lime 'Ready to grow?' pill and a large QR code in a rounded frame.
whatItMeans: The electric violet and lime contrast reads bold and youthful for a business message; arcs soften the corporate photo.
techniques: Frame a group photo with a thick contrasting arc.
Highlight the key phrase in the accent colour.
Give the QR code a big rounded frame as the focal CTA.
Echo partial rings in corners to link a two-post set.

vocabulary.definition: A curved band that masks or frames a photo.
A rounded capsule holding short text.
